items.title: Twisted Masks
items.creator: Mimic
items.description:
Check out these cool abstract skins! They have bone armor! You're sure to find the perfect one for you in this lively masquerade!

• Includes 8 skins!
• Created by Mimic

items.title: TNT Demons
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
This is going to be a blast! Choose from 12 different demons skins in awesome TNT textures. Role-play as a clever evil spirit ready to play an explosive practical joke. Gear up in cute horns and sticks of dynamite and lead the charge for getting involved in all kinds of mischief.

+ 1 free skin included!

items.title: Aphmau's Back to School
items.creator: CatFace
items.description:
Show off your school pride with Aphmau's Back to School Skin Pack! Rule the school with 20 new skins – 10 school uniforms and 10 club activity outfits! Whether you’re hitting the books at study hall or leading the cheer squad, there’s a stylish look for every student! 

+2 Aphmau skins
+2 Aaron skins
+16 Friend skins featuring KC, Zane, Pierce, Kim, and MORE!

items.title: Supers VS Villains
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
Get ready for an adventure! Brave heroes use their powers to stop sneaky villains in a super exciting showdown! Be one of them now!

- 5 Super skins!
- 5 Villain skins!
- Perfect for roleplays and with friends!
- By Piki Studios

items.title: Anime School Life
items.creator: ManaLabs
items.description:
Step into the world of anime with 10 cool school-themed skins! From stylish uniforms to fun accessories, these skins let you live out your school life in true anime fashion. Perfect for showing off your unique style in the classroom or on campus!

+ 10 trendy school-themed skins!
+ Show off your anime style!
By ManaLabs

items.title: Super Heavys Add-On
items.creator: Street Studios
items.description:
Whether you're building or tearing down, planting or harvesting, Super Heavys machines can help! Add vehicles to your OWN world to work and do whatever you want... of course, wearing PPE!

- Turn rocks and dirt into a block of asphalt with the Compactor
- PPE armor
- Signs for your streets and roads
- Trucks, tractors and heavy machinery

items.title: Alien Apocalypse Add-On
items.creator: CompyCraft
items.description:
Alien invasion! An apocalypse is spreading across the world, with factions of aliens patrolling the lands! From insectoids spawning from hives to giant mechanical hulks, Alien Apocalypse will terrify you!

To defend against the aliens, craft futuristic blasters, vehicles, and armour. Use special gear such as hazmats, jetpacks, and night vision goggles for unique abilities!
items.changelog:
Hotfix 1.1:
- Dynamic light no longer clashes with buttons and item frames
- Night vision helmet activates and deactivates as intended
- Mutant entity chases the player as intended

items.title: FUNKY FISH
items.creator: Ambient Creations
items.description: Fishy and wacky! Get weird with these 5 funky fish skins!

items.title: CRUISE
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Jump onboard your very own cruise ship! Roleplay the perfect vacation with this giant cruise ship boat! Play solo or with friends!

items.title: FOOD Add-On
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description:
FOOD Add-On adds over 250+ new food and cooking tools to your world creations! One of the best Add-Ons for farming, baking, and cooking!

Includes 250+ new items

items.title: Police Roleplay
items.creator: ChewMingo
items.description: Become a police officer and protect the city! This is the ultimate police roleplay world with drivable police cars, giant city, uniforms, and more! Roleplay cops and robbers!

items.title: Cursed Add-On
items.creator: Time Trap Studios
items.description:
Free yourself from reality as we know it and unleash the chaos of a world where everything is Cursed! From party-popping Creepers to multi-purpose Mooshrooms, expect the unexpected in this hilariously twisted Add-On. How cursed will your world get?
- 80+ custom mobs
- 40+ items
- Custom crafting and loot
- By Time Trap Studios

items.title: Stitched Monsters Add-On
items.creator: SandBlock Studios
items.description:
The stiches will hold, will you?
Add this to your survival world if you dare face the Guluman, Amalgam the Cursed Mask or even the Undead Doctor and its Puppets. Craft weapons and armors to face these stitched monsters of horror. Build and create your unique minion to help you face them.
+1000 Unique Minions possibilities and abilities.
+46 Custom Weapons, Tools and Armors
items.changelog:
New Creaking Puppet
Added Spawn Eggs
Minions return Puppets
Puppets 3D in hand + sitting
Enderman Shears buffed
Removed explosion after death for Amalgam
Lower spawn rate for Undead Doctors/Amalgam/Guluman
Guluman returns your sword
Puppets now drop Cursed Fabric
Tools now work faster than hand

items.title: Security Cameras Add-On
items.creator: Cubical
items.description:
Secure your base with 10 cameras using the Security Camera Add-On!

- SPY on your friends with the PLUSHIE CAM, mob and BLOCK cam
- Thermal CAMERA to spot enemies THROUGH walls
- MOVEMENT TRACKING and logging for ultimate security (works if you're offline too!)
- Easily ADD FRIENDS and play together!

Add this Security Add-On to your own world!

by Cubical
items.changelog:
Changes in new update:
- You are no longer put in gamemode survival after exiting cameras.

items.title: Boxer Fights
items.creator: Waypoint Studios
items.description:
For the true boxing champs ready to throw down in the ring!

+ Perfect for role-play enthusiasts
+10 unique fighters

Made by Saturn Studios, published by Waypoint Studios.

items.title: Weapons++
items.creator: Chillcraft
items.description:
Craft powerful weapons with unique abilities. Summon water storms, shoot lightning, summon mobs, and use magic. Can you master them all and beat the Ender Dragon? Adventure awaits! 

+ 20 craftable weapons! 
+ Custom animations and particles
+ Multiplayer friendly 

This item uses random start areas for any new world. Endless possibilities!

items.title: Casual Gray
items.creator: Red Eagle Studios
items.description: Celebrate the brand-new pale garden biome through our collection of Casual Gray skin pack! Whether to explore, build bases or to commemorate the coming of a new biome! Choose any one of our 10 selection of skins to match the vibe!

items.title: One Blocks Civilization
items.creator: Eescal Studios
items.description: Explore a wide world made of one block gaps! Face epic boss fights, complete quests, and trade with villagers. Discover new adventures, powerful swords, and custom armor in this unique survival challenge!

items.title: Wilderness
items.creator: KiwiStars
items.description:
Ready to explore? The Wilderness skinpack brings 18 brave and bold characters, perfect for camping, climbing, crafting, or any outdoor adventure!

By KiwiStars

items.title: Elemental Void Skins
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
Magefall's new selection of colorful skins let you embody the elements! Choose from an exciting selection of abstract, stylish skins!

- 8 skins!
- By Magefall

items.title: Netherrack Mobs
items.creator: Magefall
items.description:
These mobs have been lost in the Nether for years, and they're coated in netherrack dust. Blend in to the Nether's harsh environments as just another lost soul with this dusky red collection of re-imagined mobs!

- 8 skins!
- By Magefall

items.title: Mob Wizards
items.creator: Master Duckies
items.description:
Master the mobs. Command the magic.
Step into you game as a Mob Wizard and channel the power of creepers, endermen, blazes and more. Cast your style. Rule your realm.

- 1 free skin
- 12 mob wizards

items.title: Gamer Elite
items.creator: Master Duckies
items.description:
Level up your legend with Gamer Elite – where skill meets style!
Step into the arena with confidence, clad in skins forged for champions. Whether you're streaming, or dominating the leaderboard, it's your time to play bold, look sharp, and show the world what elite really means.

- 1 free skin
- 12 gamer teens

items.title: Soulfire Fists
items.creator: Antares
items.description: Punch your way through the enemy hordes with this exclusive 10 skin pack by Antares!
